video_title: Knicks vs Spurs NBA Finals SPECIAL w/ Malika Andrews, James Jones & Will Reeve

quotes.speaker: Will Reeve
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is a Derek Jeter-esque figure for New York
quotes.excerpt: The gold standard for winners in New York in my lifetime is Derek Jeter. I see Brunson as a Jeter-esque figure.
quotes.quote: The gold standard for winners in New York in my lifetime is Derek Jeter. I see Brunson as a Jeter-esque figure.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: James Jones's locker room presence was key to the 2016 championship
quotes.excerpt: I don't think we win in 2016 without your locker room presence.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I don't think we win in 2016 without your locker room presence.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The team that wins the battle of the benches will win the series
quotes.excerpt: Whoever wins the battle of the benches is going to win the series.
quotes.quote: Whoever wins the battle of the benches is going to win the series. One is going to be exhausted. He better have oxygen on his side.

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama will bring it in Game 1 of the Conference Finals
quotes.excerpt: I have no doubt that in this arena tomorrow night, Victor Wembanyama is going to bring it.
quotes.quote: When you look at what he does in Game 1s, I have no doubt that in this arena tomorrow night, Victor Wembanyama is going to bring it.

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's youth is a strength, not a weakness
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a strength that we're young because everyone says it's impossible, but we don't know what's impossible.
quotes.quote: I think it's a strength that we're young because everyone says it's impossible, but we don't know what's impossible.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Don't underestimate the talent base on this team
quotes.excerpt: Don't underestimate the talent base on this team. It's more of the experience is more that we just haven't seen it.
quotes.quote: Don't underestimate the talent base on this team. It's more of the experience is more that we just haven't seen it. If you go look at their resume, you got Castle that won a national championship. That's a single elimination tournament. That shit ain't easy.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Experience at all levels is crucial for NBA success
quotes.excerpt: No matter what level you play, you play that, I think that plays a part of your experience going into the NBA.
quotes.quote: No matter what level you play, you play that, I think that plays a part of your experience going into the NBA. Because even I was young going into my first NBA Finals, and the pressure was on because this is Boston, and we were picked to win it all.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: The 77 Trail Blazers are the youngest team to reach the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Everyone points to the 77 Trail Blazers, right? That's the youngest team that's ever been to the NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: Everyone points to the 77 Trail Blazers, right? That's the youngest team that's ever been to the NBA Finals. Your Oklahoma City team was like a matter of months older than that team.

quotes.speaker: James Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players need to learn how to help the star player
quotes.excerpt: Every kid wants to get to the NBA and think they'll be that guy. I'm telling all these young guys, learn how to help that guy be that guy.
quotes.quote: Every kid wants to get to the NBA and think they'll be that guy. I'm telling all these young guys, learn how to help that guy be that guy. Because there's going only be one. And if you don't know how to play, if you don't understand timing, you don't understand spacing, hey, if you're not humble enough to know that certain times in the game it's just not your time, it's going to be very, very difficult to play at this level.

quotes.speaker: James Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA players must be complete, not one-dimensional
quotes.excerpt: You can't just be athletic. You can't just be fast. You can't be a one-dimensional player.
quotes.quote: You can't just be athletic. You can't just be fast. You can't be a one-dimensional player. You have to be a complete basketball player, and that means knowing every position on the floor, but knowing how to help every position on the floor be successful.

quotes.speaker: James Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: You only stay in the NBA if your team wins
quotes.excerpt: You only stay in the NBA if your team wins. I'm not I can score 20, I won't be here.
quotes.quote: I realize when you're at the end of the bench, you're the 15th man, you only stay in the NBA if your team wins. I'm not I can score 20, I won't be here. I'm only in the NBA if my team wins.

quotes.speaker: James Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Riley taught me that you remember who you played with
quotes.excerpt: You won't remember the games, you'll remember who you played the games with.
quotes.quote: Pat Riley was like, as good as he was, like he's a Hall of Fame top player ever. He's like, you won't remember the games, you'll remember who you played the games with. And if they remember you, you guys will make a lot of memories for a long time and you'll play a long time in this league.

quotes.speaker: Will Reeve
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks reflect the city's diverse and melting pot nature
quotes.excerpt: The team reflects what the city sees itself as, as this collection of people from all different backgrounds.
quotes.quote: The team reflects what the city sees itself as, as this collection of people from all different backgrounds, from different walks of life, from different life experiences. They come together in this in this melting pot, and you're led by Jalen Brunson, who's been counted out for so long and yet he just delivers, delivers.

quotes.speaker: Will Reeve
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is a top-three player in New York sports history
quotes.excerpt: In my lifetime, which is since 1992, he would be top three. I would say Jeter, Eli, then Brunson.
quotes.quote: In my lifetime, which is since 1992, he would be top three. I would say Jeter, Eli, then Brunson. But the second Brunson wins a second one, he's maybe number one.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Derek Jeter ran and owned New York sports
quotes.excerpt: Derek Jeter, I ain't seen a lot like that. He ran the city, he owned the city.
quotes.quote: Derek Jeter, I ain't seen a lot like that. He ran the city, he owned the city, in the most humble of way.
